name: dude
description: Yet another AI workflow: planning, implementation, PR delivery, review, simplification, and investigation skills that wire into one another

interface.shortDescription: Planning, implementation, PR delivery, review, and investigation workflows
interface.longDescription: dude carries a change from an issue to a pull request whose CI passes and whose review is clean, and root-causes a problem before any change is proposed. Each skill names the next flow rather than absorbing it, and each has its own gate.
defaultPrompt: Plan this issue into PR-sized tasks.
Take this task to a branch of verified commits.
